scope: Fixed-cohort MSD/H bootstrap validation; other bands not recomputed
baseline: 50 km cell x initial-altitude class x month of year; all years pooled
position: archived initial position lat0/lon0, one cell per flight

grid.projection: WGS84 UTM; regular six-degree longitude zones
grid.boundaries: half-open squares, clipped to zone and hemisphere
grid.size_convention: projected metres, small UTM ground-scale distortion
grid.coverage: UTM domain [-80,84] latitude; all archive origins included

sampling_frame: occupied archive groups, then fixed cohort; equal-flight mean
catalogue_export_note: Portable cell catalogue copied from the same measurement run; numerical results unchanged.
